Subject: Re: Proposal: Apex Cloud Adapter integration + Sell-With playbook

Hi Lena / Tom —

Appreciate the quick turn. Answers inline below and proposed agenda for the tech sync.

Q: Licensing model for Sell-With?
A: Our standard is a tiered referral/rev-share for joint-sold marketplace SKUs; for early pilots we often do a fixed credit + rev-share split to make commercial motion simple while we measure signal. I've attached a sample pricing worksheet (sellwith-draft-pricing.xlsx).

Q: SSO / API auth expectations?
A: We support OAuth2 OIDC for admin flows and API key for server-to-server. For marketplace listings, SSO to the partner console is optional but recommended for co-sell operations.

Q: Listing redlines?
A: Typical asks are around data residency and telemetry sampling. We can pre-clear our standard language; Olga can own the legal checklist.

Proposed tech sync agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) High-level architecture & data flow (15m)
3) Auth, SSO, and tenancy model (15m)
4) Marketplace listing requirements & entitlement mapping (15m)
5) Next steps / MAP owners (10m)

Tom — can you propose two morning PT slots? Vivek / Olga — can you review the attached integration spec and call out any high-risk items before the sync?

Thanks,
Ben

Ben / team —

Thanks — available slots: Thu May 2 09:30 PT or Fri May 3 10:00 PT. Prefer Thu.

A few prelim notes from a technical perspective:
- We need to confirm whether the adapter will run in the customer's cloud account (partner-managed) or as a managed connector in Redwood's infra. That will determine entitlement mapping and billing flow.
- SSO: we can support OIDC, and we have an existing SCIM connector for provisioning; can Redwood take provisioning calls?
- Marketplace listing: we will need an operations contact for co-sell leads and a tagging strategy so leads are attributed correctly.

Also attaching our internal compliance checklist (we'll send offline) — most items are routine but we will validate encryption-in-transit and storage options.
